en:
Why are you dragging your feet!?
Let's go in already!

You remembered my little trick. Well, you *are*
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>, after all!

I wonder what it's like inside!
I'm so excited!

Going in without permission... I won't cover 
for you when Angie gets mad, y'know?

Let's hurry and check inside. If nothing's
wrong...then that's fine.
Nyeeeh? You guys again?

Himiko...why are you here?
Were you keeping watch this whole time?

I wouldn't do something like that. It sounds 
like a pain... I just came to check on Angie.

So what do you guys want? Don't tell me
you came to stop Angie again.
Ah...yeah.

Because the <CLT=cltSTRONG>ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL> is Monokuma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
we shouldn't just *let* it happen.

Th-That's exactly right! It's not because 
I'm scared or anything, okay!?
But it's good that you're here.

She won't open this door for anyone but
members of the student council, right?
So tell Angie to open it for us.
Nyeeeh...that's not possible.
Not possible?

I wanted to ask her how the ritual went, 
so I've been calling to her...

But she must really be into her work...
She won't come out.

...Won't come out? Are you sure she's
in there?

She should be inside...
Both this door and the back one are locked.
Both doors are locked?

<CLT=cltMIND>I grabbed the knob and tried
to turn it.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...click...click...*
It really is locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>But these doors only lock
from the inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means there's definitely
someone in there...
...Any response?

Actually...no.
Maybe she's sleeping.
<CLT=cltMIND>No answer?
Himiko! We need to get inside right now!
Nyeeeh...? Why?

But y'know, even if we wanted to check,
it's locked, so we can't do—

I heard everything, and I'm just as shocked as
you are by what the tabloids are reporting!
You obviously didn't hear anything at all!
Where did you come from...?

A little birdie told me that now would be a
good time to bust out my trick.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's trick?
Ah, the lock picking!
Huh? Lock picking?

During the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Kokichi
was able to get into our rooms by lock picking.

Can you use your lock picking skills
to get this lab door open?

...You want me to pick open this door, huh?
Hmmm, lemme see...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi bent over and peeked into
the keyhole of the doorknob.

Ooh, it's a cylinder lock. Now this type of
lock is perfect for lock picking.
Yes! Please, Kokichi, open the lock!
It's rude to pick a lock without permission.

Now's not the time for that!
Something might've happened to Angie!

D-Don't worry about that!
Kokichi, hurry up and open the door!

Sorry, Himiko. I'm only doing this because
these three are threatening me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi pulled out some thin needles,
and stuck them into the keyhole of the lock.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...click...*
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...*clack*
There, open says me.
That simple...?

Nee-heehee... Not to brag, but I am the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL>, y'know.

Lock picking seems more suited to petty
thieves.
Aaaaaack! That cuts real deep, Maki!
Let's get inside! I'm worried about Angie!
Yeah, you're right!

<CLT=cltMIND>When I touched the doorknob, I realized
that my palms were sweating from fear.
<CLT=cltMIND>Fear...? Why am I nervous...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I turned the doorknob, pushed open
the door, and saw...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong, dong ding!*
...A-BODY-HAS-BEEN-DISCOVERED.

EVERYONE, PLEASE-ASSEMBLE-AT-THE-
<CLT=cltSTRONG>ULTIMATE-ART-LAB<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...BLRGHBLRBLRGHBLRBLRGHBLRB!

Ahhh! She puked again!
And it's green this time!

Monophanie's green puke is said to be an
omen of bad luck and disaster!
What on earth is about to happen!?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
